description: This file contains functions for managing code snippets, including fetching, creating, updating, deleting, and toggling public access, using Supabase as backend.

methods.name: getSnippets
methods.description: Fetches a list of snippets with optional search, tag filtering, and pagination.

methods.name: getSnippetById
methods.description: Retrieves a single snippet by its ID.

methods.name: createSnippet
methods.description: Creates a new snippet, attaching user ownership and timestamps.

methods.name: updateSnippet
methods.description: Updates an existing snippet after verifying ownership.

methods.name: deleteSnippet
methods.description: Deletes a snippet after verifying ownership.

methods.name: togglePublic
methods.description: Changes the public visibility of a snippet after ownership verification.
